summary.text: Jane Wisialowski is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican Barbara Labriola in a race with no incumbent.
She is a member of the Old Saybrook school board and ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Wisialowski is listed by Ballotpedia as a present officeholder on the Old Saybrook School District board, serving at-large.

She was the Democratic and Working Families Party nominee for District 23 in the 2024 general election, when she lost to incumbent Republican Devin Carney, 51.5 percent to 48.5 percent (8,044 votes to 7,582).
